en: Colorized vintage view over a riverside town nestled in a valley, with red‑roofed houses in the foreground, rocky riverbanks, trees and gardens, and laundry hanging on lines. On the hill to the right stands a fortified complex with towers and a large castle-like building. The sky is blue with a few clouds. Red printed captions identify the scene as Bautzen and the castle complex Schloss Ortenburg.
